headline: Executive session on union negotiations and litigation, followed by a regular meeting covering school curriculum, enrollment, and AI guidelines.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to discuss collective bargaining with several unions and litigation involving the Waltham Educators Association/MTA, case MUP-26-12065. The regular meeting will cover curriculum highlights, unfinished business including AI guidelines and school enrollment, and fiscal matters including bills on warrant.
